title: perk-workbench plugin test evidence
description: Machine-readable outcome document of `perk-workbench plugin test --json EXECUTABLE`: the self-contained release evidence for one external plugin against the perk/v1 conformance suite. The document is deterministic except per-case durations and the resolved executable path, and never carries credentials, connection targets, form values, statements, or raw protocol frames. Unknown members MUST be ignored (additive evolution, per protocol/perk-v1/policy.md); a future document shape bumps evidence_version.

host_version.description: Host build identity: "perk-workbench <version>", where <version> is injected at build time via -ldflags=-X main.version=... and "devel" when not injected.

contract_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical perk/v1 contract asset set — schema.json, fixtures/manifest.json, and every fixture frame — in sorted name order with explicit length framing. Any asset drift changes this digest.

path.description: The resolved canonical executable path (filepath.Abs + EvalSymlinks) once resolution succeeded.

executable_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical executable bytes — the fingerprint a release archive's binary must match.

error.description: Suite-level failure (interrupt, setup, resolution, hashing) when the run could not complete.

capabilitiesIdentity.description: The plugin's advertised capabilities identity, captured from the initialize handshake (no backend required). The v1 protocol advertises no implementation version, so none is reported.
